title: Preparation of three-dimensional palygorskite based carrier
author: Wang, Shen, et al.

steps.title: Pretreat palygorskite
steps.instruction: Wash palygorskite with water, perform acid treatment, adjust the suspension pH to neutral, centrifuge, then dry the solid at 105 °C for 5 h.

steps.title: Disperse activated Pal in toluene
steps.instruction: Add the hydrochloric‑acid‑activated or thermally treated palygorskite to a three‑necked flask containing toluene and ultrasonically disperse for 1 h.

steps.title: Graft TDI onto Pal
steps.instruction: Introduce a toluene solution containing 2,4‑toluene diisocyanate (TDI) to the dispersion and stir at room temperature for 24 h so that –NCO groups are grafted onto the Pal surface.

steps.title: Couple diols to isocyanate‑Pal
steps.instruction: Heat the reaction mixture to 80 °C, add diols of the desired molecular weight at a molar ratio of 0.25 relative to TDI, and maintain at 80 °C for 8 h to covalently bond the diols to the surface isocyanate groups.

steps.title: Purify and freeze‑dry 3D Pal
steps.instruction: Wash the resulting material sequentially with ethanol and deionized water, then freeze‑dry to obtain the three‑dimensional palygorskite carrier.

steps.title: Prepare silane‑diamine solution
steps.instruction: In a three‑necked flask add 4 mL 3‑isocyanate propyl triethoxy silane (IPTS) and the stoichiometric amount of a diamine to 40 mL toluene, stir and reflux for 2 h at 40 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Pal slurry
steps.instruction: Add 10 g hydrochloric‑acid‑activated or thermally treated Pal to 60 mL toluene in a beaker and ultrasonically disperse for 1 h.

steps.title: React slurry with silane‑diamine mixture
steps.instruction: Transfer the Pal slurry into the silane‑diamine flask, raise the temperature to 80 °C, and reflux for 12 h.

steps.title: Wash and freeze‑dry final product
steps.instruction: Wash the product repeatedly with deionized water, extract with absolute ethanol, and freeze‑dry for 24 h to obtain a loose powder of three‑dimensional Pal.
